List and manage AI agents.

Usage:
  camber agent [command]

Available Commands:
  context     Manage agent knowledge base context
  create      Create an agent
  list        List all agents
  pull        Pull an agent mirror into the current project
  push        Push local mirror context changes to Camber
  skill       Manage agent skills
  team        Manage agent teams
  update      Update an agent

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for agent

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Use "camber agent [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Create, list, delete, and manage app resources.

Usage:
  camber app [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create a new application
  delete      Delete an application
  describe    Describe an application
  list        List all applications
  run         Run an application

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for app

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Use "camber app [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Send a message to a Camber AI agent and stream the response to your terminal.

Usage:
  camber chat [flags]
  camber chat [command]

Available Commands:
  status      Check the status/result of an async chat run

Flags:
  -a, --agent string             Agent tag (e.g. @nova.snowflake; also set via AGENT_TAG env var)
      --async                    Submit the chat and return immediately with a conversation id and link; poll 'camber chat status' for the result
      --cid string               Same as --conversation-id
  -c, --conversation-id string   Optional UUID of an existing chat session to continue
      --effort string            Reasoning effort for this chat: low, medium, or high; defaults to the model's default
  -h, --help                     help for chat
  -m, --message string           Message to send to the agent
      --model string             Model to use for this chat. Available: bedrock:claude-sonnet-4-6 (default), bedrock:claude-opus-4-6-v1, bedrock:claude-opus-4-8, bedrock:claude-sonnet-5, bedrock:claude-opus-5
      --no-thinking              Disable extended thinking for this chat (only supported by some models)
  -o, --output string            Use "json" for non-streaming output: one JSON line with result and output_stash_files
      --stop                     With --async: stop the conversation's current run and start a new message (requires --conversation-id)

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Use "camber chat [command] --help" for more information about a command.
